g.text: MarieEntratiDay2 begins.
Drifter. I have taken some time to think and to... calm myself. I have a strict rule regarding engaging in conversations while I am furieuse.
Evaluate expressions
It was... a dagger between the ribs you paid me, yesterday. I admit I fled in anger, oui, but also répulsion. Not at you, but at myself.
MarieEntrati5a
But before we continue, I must address one matter first - your own tone when speaking to me. I know you must think me a child. You are centuries old, if not more.
MarieEntrati5b
I spent much time thinking over your words. That this is not a holy war and that le Cardinal has been manipulative in his ways.
MarieEntrati5c
You were... of course, correct in your question to ask me where in the scriptures of Sol it states that innocents are expendable. It does not.
MarieEntrati5d
Before we continue, I must address one matter first - your willingness to wield my faith against me in an argument, where you do not engage with faith yourself.
MarieEntrati5e

I... am sorry for fleeing our conversation yesterday. It was simply too much. I must ask you, though, before we continue - did you mean your words ? Or were you merely trying to manipulate my feelings to spare yourself an uncomfortable argument ?
MarieEntrati5f
It appears we have come to an impasse, in regards to le Cardinal, oui ? You view him as a monstre, and I, a saint.
MarieEntrati5g
I wish to speak to you about your decision to side with Entrati only to get into my good graces, if you are willing.
MarieEntrati5h
I wish to speak to you about your lie, now, if you are willing.
MarieEntrati5i
Chat ends.
false
How could I be surprised that you were so deadly precise with your aim ? To compare my words with that of the devil...
You have traveled through unknown dimensions, through the Void itself. Battled gods and angels. Who am I, to you, oui ? Just silly little Marie.
And I believe... oui, you are correct. This is not a holy war. For there is no such thing. War is never holy, just, or righteous. Pain should never be the guiding light.
War is never holy, just, or righteous. Pain should never be the guiding light.
This was disingenuous, Drifter. Cruel, and ineffectual. It was an attempt to "win" a conversation, and it was not how one should comport oneself.
I meant my words. I'm sorry if my timing was... off. I care about you deeply, Marie...
I didn't mean them, I was just... caught up. I'm very, very sorry. The passion of the moment.
However... I do not wish to leave things in such a way between us. You are a kind soul, and there is much between us that I do not want to leave soured.
Attempting to manipulate the situation in order to control my feelings is... disingenuous and cruel. I admit I am eager to hate you for it, Drifter.
I would think myself someone whose mind and heart is open to the world and all those within it. And you succinctly, and with a single barbed arrow, proved me wrong.
On one hand, I understand this. I sympathize. Both our tempers were raised. But on the other, I ask for you to regard me instead with more grace and tact than you have.
Even what we do now - destroying the Murmure and fighting against all your many enemies - is not the path of the Luminaries.
Faith is not, nor should it ever be, a weapon to be used against another. It is a shield. A light in the darkness. A voice to guide the way.
Before I face the - the enormity of that, I must explain myself regarding le Cardinal, s'il vous plaît.
Update boolean DrifterMarie
Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete
However... I do not wish to leave things in such a way between us. There is much between us that I do not want to leave soured.
I suppose I am here pour m'excuser - to say I am deeply sorry for being so foolishly entrenched. I hope you understand.
For I have lived on the streets. I have lived every day of my life in physical agonie. I have known heartbreak, I have known love, I have known fear and rejection. I have known life and loss.
Necessary as it may be to lift the sword, lest the world be overrun by their ilk, it is not to be venerated. And it is certainly not excusable when innocents are harmed in its wake.

And for you to attempt to use it against me to simply "defeat" me? It was a cowardly tactic. But both our tempers were raised, and I will... forgive you, if you will forgive me, for words said in anger.
It is hard for me, I think, to abandon my defense of le Cardinal... and it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
Non, I understand... How many murders have been committed as "crimes of passion," oui ? Certainly as many children have been created in moments of them as well.
And you have become important to me, in such a short time... I have found our conversations so joyeuses.
true
Indeed, I still wish to see Monsieur Loid united with those above. I wish to see solace brought to le Cardinal's remaining family, and you are the road to this !
false
Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete
I do. And I'm sorry if my words hurt you. I just didn't know how else to say them.
I'm glad my words go through to you. I was starting to lose hope.
And if you truly believe yourself to so high above us all, than you will see nothing but the clouds in which you are lost.
So... I will concede that le Cardinal is not justified in harming others in the name of a "greater good."
I got frustrated, but I don't know how else to make you see sense. Entrati isn't your friend. Or your father.
I'm sorry. I let my temper get the better of me, and I said things I didn't mean to.
I simply do not want you to think less of me if I were to confess to you the truth of it all. It seems so small and pathétique.
I am... disappointed. Hurt. But I... I forgive you.
Evaluate expressions
And there is much kindness you could still serve to do toward my Lyon and even toward the devil, I suppose...
true
Indeed, I still wish to see Monsieur Loid united with those above. I wish to see solace brought to le Cardinal's remaining family, and you are the road to this !
false
+10 Chemistry
There is something to be said for being gracious when one "wins," you know.
For what "greater good" will be left, when nothing but shattered lives and hearts remain in his path ?
Non. He is not my father. For my father abandoned me in the street as a child, and le Cardinal did nothing nearly so cruel.
Many travesties have been committed in the heat of passion. Such is the way of things.
I think I already know what it might be.
I won't think less of you, Marie. I promise.
To... finish the conversation regarding le Cardinal, if we may - setting aside my heartbreak, s'il te plaît ?
Indeed, how can I push you away, when you have confessed to me how you feel ?
DrifterMarie
Indeed, how can I push you away, when you have confessed to me how you feel about our dear Lyon ? You could bring him such peace... such solace...
DrifterLyon
Indeed, how can I push you away, when you seem set upon the devil ? I do not understand your tastes, but... it seems you are to be at our side, oui ?
DrifterRoathe
I do not wish to lose you as a companion. Can we push this all to one side, and say that we may not agree, but that we can still continue on ?
false
Marie, wait. Please. Let me apologize.
I didn't honestly think what I said to you mattered - I didn't think it'd be that important to you.
I appreciate that more than you can know, thank you.
I was just teasing.
Sorry. I don't "win" very often.
Update boolean MarieFamilyFail
+5 Chemistry
I suppose it would be obvious to you, non ? Someone who has lost their famille as well.
We shall see. I think in the end, I saw in him a bit of the father that abandoned me, as small and sad as that seems to me now.
It is hard for me, I think, to abandon my defense of le Cardinal... and it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
Can we push this all to one side, and say that we may not agree, but that we can still continue on ?
No, I'm not done sorting this through. We need to finish this conversation.
I think that's fair. I agree.
I do forgive you for your lies, Drifter. We can continue to be friends and allies. But to lie to me the way you have, simply in an attempt to... what ?
It is hard for me, I think, to abandon my défense of le Cardinal... and it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
Oui, yes, well.
+5 Chemistry
Add -10 to Family
I accept your apology... as I also let my temper best me at several points.
To think... that after all these years, that I could be pulled in by someone offering me such kindness ?
I simply do not want you to think less of me if I were to confess to you the truth of it all. It seems so small and pathétique.
Update boolean MarieFamilyFail
+5 Chemistry
Check boolean DrifterMarieWhoops
I simply do not want you to think less of me if I were to confess to you the truth of it all. It seems so small and pathétique.
Update boolean MarieEntratiCompleteB
Allow me to simply... explain, I think, why it is so hard for me to abandon my defense of le Cardinal. And why it took me some time to understand why I could not let him go.
Foolish little Marie... of course, he was not all that he seemed.
I think I already know what it might be.
I won't think less of you, Marie. I promise.
Add -10 to Family
Bien. At least we have an accord.
To climb into bed with me ? It is foul.
true
To use me ? It is foul.
false
I think I already know what it might be.
I won't think less of you, Marie. I promise.
Update boolean MarieNoDate
You're not a fool, Marie. You're anything but. If anything, this proves to me how wonderful you really are.
You've become so important to me, Marie... and I'm so sorry that this conversation has gone the way that it has.
I suppose it would be obvious to you, non ? Someone who has lost their famille as well.
We shall see. I think in the end, I saw in him a bit of the father that abandoned me, as small and sad as that seems to me now.
Je ne pense pas.
À la revoyure.
So I must say I could never trust you with my heart. I would say I am sorry for such words, which I am certain must disappoint you -
I suppose it would be obvious to you, non ? Someone who has lost their famille as well.
We shall see. I think in the end, I saw in him a bit of the father that abandoned me, as small and sad as that seems to me now.
Chat ends.
But I needed you to see that Entrati could be complicated. That he could cause damage in equal measure. I didn't want you to be hurt worse, later.
To think... that after all these years, that I could be pulled in by someone offering me such kindness ?
Update boolean MarieEntratiCompleteB
Update boolean MarieEntratiCompleteC
But I fear I am not. I do hope this does not come as a surprise.
To think... that after all these years, that I could be pulled in by someone offering me such kindness ?
Stupidly, I think I was trying to do this all to protect you.
Foolish little Marie... of course, he was not all that he seemed.
Update boolean MarieWillDate
Update boolean MarieWillDate
As for the matter of le Cardinal ? I suppose we shall remain parted on the topic. As we shall remain parted in our affections.
Foolish little Marie... of course, he was not all that he seemed.
Evaluate expressions
No, he was kind to you. That wasn't a lie. But that doesn't mean that's all he is, and all he's capable of.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
Au revoir.
[Confess feelings.] You're not a fool, Marie. You're anything but. If anything, this proves to me how wonderful you really are.
And you tell me this while you also confess your love to the brother of my soul ?! Do you think to play us both to be fools ?!
LyonDating
And you tell me this while you tarry with the devil ?! Do you think to play us both to be fools ?!
RoatheDating
I... Oh, mon cœur. Mon cœur ! Oh, how I feel the same ! But I did not dare speak the words, I did not dare write them to you - for I thought myself a fool for them.
false
Oui, as you said, and so I now see plainly. I... am simply left to thank you for your patience once more.
Update boolean MarieNoDate
You've become so important to me, Marie... and I'm so sorry that this conversation has gone the way that it has.
Update boolean DrifterMarieWhoops
Ah ! You have made me so happy ! I wonder... what you intend to do with this statement... ?
In my desperation to hold on to a father now gone, I nearly drove away a family still here.
Update boolean MarieEntratiCompleteB
But I needed you to see that Entrati could be complicated. That he could cause damage in equal measure. I didn't want you to be hurt worse, later.
Update boolean MarieNoDate
[Ask to date.] Well, I was wondering... if you'd like to, well... become a couple?
I figured we would take our time with it. We're still learning about each other.
And I think I am not the only one, non ? I... think I am now properly armed to help with the battle we face with those upstairs, oui ?
Update boolean MarieFamilyFail
Stupidly, I think I was trying to do this all to protect you.

Tu crois pouvoir débarquer ici depuis le futur et tous nous manipuler comme des marionnettes ?! Je te suggère de prendre cette machine, de te pencher et de te l'enfoncer fermement dans le derrière, espèce de sale pourriture répugnante et puante !
A "couple ?" My dear wolf, I do believe times have changed since my era of fiancés and arranged marriages... I hardly doubt you are asking to wed !
Oui, that is sensible. Quite sensible. I come from a time of formal courtship, oui ? Though I would be curious to know how times have changed.
+10 Chemistry
Chat ends.
Evaluate expressions
Update boolean MarieEntratiCompleteB
But if you are asking for a more... formal courtship, then oui ! Oui ! I would like this.
Things have definitely evolved a bit. I wouldn't say they're more "formal" but I'm definitely happy to... show you.
Definitely not offering marriage, not yet.
จนกว่าจะพบกันใหม่ ? À la revoyure.

Oh !
false

Hah ! I know when you are being wicked. Well. I look forward to it.
Now I am the one teasing, do not worry. But, either way, je suis ravie! And looking forward to learning these new... romantique customs.

Update boolean DrifterMarieWhoops
Update boolean DrifterMarie
Chat ends.

Update boolean MarieNoDate
I - oh my...
Until then ? À la revoyure, mon cœur.
Chat ends.
